title: Bug-Bounty Economics Applied to AI Vulnerability Disclosure Policy

original_idea.body:
# Bug-Bounty Economics Applied to AI Vulnerability Disclosure Policy

**Problem:** Coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD) and bug bounties shaped cybersecurity governance; AI flaw/jailbreak disclosure lacks comparable norms, and we don't know how labs' disclosure policies measure up against mature CVD standards.

**Direction:** Transfer the ISO 29147/30111 CVD framework and bug-bounty design principles. Code a sample of AI companies' public vulnerability/flaw-disclosure and bug-bounty pages against CVD maturity dimensions (scope, safe-harbor, timelines, severity rubric, researcher protections). Score and compare.

**Why it matters:** Maps a proven governance mechanism onto AI and quantifies the gap, supporting incident-response framework development. All on public policy pages; valuable outside any single lab.

**Relevant context:** ISO 29147/30111 CVD standards; AI flaw-disclosure proposals; The Future Society NTSB-for-AI incident-response framing.
